name: JellyMold Companion
overview: Watch history for JellyMold and any other app.
description: A permanent record of everything each person watches and listens to on this server, readable by each person from an app. Survives media being deleted from the library; never deletes history.

versions.changelog: Subtitles on time in CarPlay, HomeView and AirPlay: Jellyfin's stream with the plugin's own subtitles, timed right and in 6-second pieces, for JellyMold to use where the plugin is installed. Nothing to switch on.
Ratings from other sites: with your own free MDBList API key, IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and more for each film and series, so JellyMold can show the one each person prefers.

Your stats on the web: each person sees their stats in any browser at /JellyMold/Stats, laid out as JellyMold shows them. JellyMold Stats is in everyone's Jellyfin menu (an admin can take it out) and in the dashboard's menu; admins can choose whose stats to see.
The settings page opens with a short note that the plugin is made for JellyMold, the Jellyfin app for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, with a link to it on the App Store.

Measures the black bars in widescreen films, so JellyMold opens them already cropped. Undo on the settings page works, and previews nobody imported are cleared after a day. Preparing subtitles and putting the resume point back are now on by default. Music and audiobook settings are hidden for now. A play resumed as the plugin starts, and undoing an import, keep what was played.

Phase 3: a store for each person and the household, quiz results and a household leaderboard, learned skip segments for every app, putting the resume point back after an app vanishes (Jellyfin 10.10), subtitles prepared ahead, and the home screen in one request. Includes Phases 1 and 2.
